time_stretch_ratio_meaning: output duration / input duration of track B (pitch preserved)
mapping: anchored every 4 beats (beat map followed bar by bar)
offset_meaning: B's start-bar downbeat (B time tB) plays at A's start-bar downbeat (A time tA). B time t plays at A time tA + (t - tB) * ratio (+ onset refinement). offset_s = tA - tB.
notes: Large tempo change for B (35%: 93.0 -> 124.0 BPM). Stretches beyond ~8% start to sound unnatural; a DJ would usually pick a closer track or mix at half/double time.

reference_check.what: B's reference beats mapped through the stretch vs A's reference beats
